Ec Rule Z Resource Delete Self Forwarding Rule
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecRules/self/:ruleId

Deletes a log and control forwarding rule based on the rule ID.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the rule.
